panels.title: 🎯 Top Inbound Mule Targets (Fan-In Analysis)
panels.description: Destination accounts receiving money from multiple senders within the selected time window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dest_bank AS "Dest Bank", CASE WHEN length(dest_account) > 28 THEN substring(dest_account from 1 for 16) || '...' || substring(dest_account from length(dest_account)-6) ELSE dest_account END AS "Beneficiary Account/QR", count(DISTINCT source_account) AS "Unique Senders (Fan-In)", count(*) AS "Inbound Deposits", to_char(sum(amount), 'FM999,999,999,990.00') AS "Total Inflow Volume", MAX(currency) AS "Ccy", to_char(MAX(timestamp), 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "Last Active (UTC)" FROM fraud_monitoring.transactions WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY dest_bank, dest_account HAVING count(DISTINCT source_account) >= 2 OR count(*) >= 3 ORDER BY "Unique Senders (Fan-In)" DESC, "Inbound Deposits" DESC LIMIT 15;

panels.title: 📤 Top Outbound Dispersers (Fan-Out Analysis)
panels.description: Source accounts distributing funds to multiple destination accounts within the selected time window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source_bank AS "Source Bank", CASE WHEN length(source_account) > 28 THEN substring(source_account from 1 for 16) || '...' || substring(source_account from length(source_account)-6) ELSE source_account END AS "Source Account", count(DISTINCT dest_account) AS "Unique Recipients (Fan-Out)", count(*) AS "Outbound Transfers", to_char(sum(amount), 'FM999,999,999,990.00') AS "Total Outflow Volume", MAX(currency) AS "Ccy", to_char(MAX(timestamp), 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "Last Active (UTC)" FROM fraud_monitoring.transactions WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY source_bank, source_account HAVING count(DISTINCT dest_account) >= 2 OR count(*) >= 3 ORDER BY "Unique Recipients (Fan-Out)" DESC, "Outbound Transfers" DESC LIMIT 15;

panels.title: 🚨 Real-Time High-Risk Geo Corridors & Alerts Feed

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Time (UTC)", tx_id AS "Reference ID", source_bank || ' ➔ ' || dest_bank AS "Corridor", source_bank AS "From Bank", source_account AS "From Account", dest_bank AS "To Bank", dest_account AS "To Account/QR", currency AS "Ccy", to_char(amount, 'FM999,999,999,990.00') AS "Amount", risk_score AS "Risk Score", array_to_string(reasons, ', ') AS "Triggers", alert_status AS "Status" FROM fraud_monitoring.fraud_alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100;
